text.en: Without rules the oceans could become dangerous and chaotic, with more pollution, accidents, collisions and disputes over resources.
Maritime rules set common standards for all ships, regardless of the country they belong to.
So countries can cooperate in using marine resources without conflict, while marine life, ships, sailors and coastal communities stay protected.

explanation.en: Maritime rules set common standards for all ships. They help keep the oceans safe, clean and open for trade and travel, and let countries use marine resources without conflict. Without them there would be more pollution, accidents, collisions and disputes.

hints.en: Start with what could go wrong without rules.
Then say who the rules protect.
